Thanks Camila — quick note on the evaluation plan items we typically run for marketplace listings so CloudBridge knows what to expect:

Evaluation phases:
- Phase 0: Access & smoke (1–2 days) — confirm staging instance, run basic prompts, verify KV cache behavior and token accounting
- Phase 1: Performance validation (3–5 days) — P50/P95 latency under expected request mixes, warm/cold start behavior, KV cache hit-rate analysis
- Phase 2: Load & cost (3–7 days) — continuous throughput run to validate autoscaling and quantify per-token costs at target qps
- Phase 3: Regression & quality checks (ongoing) — evals on a small prompt set (we'll provide metrics and acceptance criteria)

We’ll need:
- Staging API key and test dataset (anonymized)
- Expected QPS and typical request shapes (median/95th token lengths)
- Any compliance docs required by AWS (Priya, happy to coordinate)

I’ll attach a short MAP template (xlsx) with suggested owners and deadlines; Camila, feel free to edit.
